summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Smith & Nephew PLC, a UK-based medical technology company, announcing the timing of its first quarter 2026 trading report. The filing provides the date and time for the release of quarterly results and the accompanying analyst conference call. No special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is indicated. The filing is a standard periodic disclosure by a foreign private issuer and does not trigger a special-situation classification.
